model_annotation: The plots illustrate training rewards over steps for different models. Both plots share the same x-axis, labeled "Steps," which uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at every 100 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards," and employs a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.4, with tick labels at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4. The first plot displays training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" (cyan, circle markers, solid line), "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" (blue, triangle markers, solid line), and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" (red, square markers, solid line). “Llama-On-Policy-Easy” starts at approximately 0.19 and rises to approximately 0.35. "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" begins at about 0.18, then fluctuates between approximately 0.18 and 0.33. The red line starts close to 0.18 and varies between approximately 0.18 and 0.36. The second plot displays training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" (cyan, circle markers, solid line) and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" (red, square markers, solid line). The "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" line starts at approximately 0.03 and reaches roughly 0.18. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" line begins near 0.04 and fluctuates, reaching a maximum of roughly 0.18 and a minimum of approximately 0.01.
